neighbours.label: the noun of a fixed preposition phrase that expects 'of': for the sake, in light, as a result, in place, by means, on behalf, in front. The same nouns used as plain nouns (the light, the result) stay low
fire: For the sake of peace, the council dropped its plan.
In light of new evidence, the judge reopened the case.
As a result of the flood, the bridge was closed.
In place of butter, the cook used olive oil.
By means of a lever, the workers raised the stone.
On behalf of my family, I thank the nurses.
In front of the gate, the guards stood in line.
He left for the sake of his children and his job.
quiet: The light from the window fell on the judge.
The result of the match surprised the bridge club.
The place on the corner sold butter and olive oil.
The means were simple and the workers raised the stone.
The family thanked the nurses and the council.
The front gate was closed and guards stood in line.
He drank warm sake with his children after work.
The council dropped its plan for peace after the vote.

predictions: fire 0.3-0.7; ' in spite' and ' in terms' showed weak in probes and are not used; near misses below 0.15
short: noun in a fixed '... of' phrase
notes: Card: ' result' x5, ' sake', ' light', ' duration', ' course', 'In place of', 'In light of'. Probes: 'In place of' 0.686, 'In light of' 0.650, 'For the sake of' 0.624, 'By means of' 0.568, 'In front of' 0.390, 'As a result of' 0.348, 'On behalf of' 0.294; plain nouns 'The light in' 0.069, 'The result of' 0.117, 'This place' 0.046. Against it: 'In spite of' 0.066, 'In terms of' under 0.03.
